en.name: Shamil Abdulaev
en.role: Systems & Python Infrastructure Engineer · Saint Petersburg
en.summary: Systems and distributed platforms engineer with {years} of experience architecting high-throughput backend infrastructure, asynchronous engines (Litestar, Faust), and Go microservices. Core contributor to foundational open-source runtimes: 39+ merged PRs to CPython, 12 accepted patches to glibc, and 10 commits to SQLAlchemy. Proven expertise in architecting isolated multi-tenant PaaS, slashing deployment cycles by 90%, reducing sub-system p95 latency by 56%, and engineering enterprise-grade MCP servers for LLM-agent orchestration.
en.oss_summary: Improved core global runtimes through 39+ merged PRs to CPython and 12 accepted patches to the foundational glibc system library, resolving critical memory safety anomalies, free-threading data races, and JIT compiler issues while optimizing low-level system calls and internal data structures.

experience.title: Python Developer
bullets: Architected a multi-tenant PaaS platform for dynamic orchestration and isolation of customer environments using Kubernetes and a custom control plane, cutting enterprise client onboarding from 48 hours to 12 minutes and reducing server costs by 42% through dense node utilization while maintaining a 99.95% SLA across 60+ isolated instances.

Decomposed a distributed platform monolith into domain services and parallelized CI/CD build pipelines, reducing release delivery cycles from 3.5 hours to 15 minutes and deployment failure rates by 88%, saving the product engineering team over 160 hours monthly.

Engineered a fault-tolerant enterprise CRM integration and synchronization platform with predictive Redis Token Bucket throttling and a custom production-ready MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, enabling autonomous LLM agents to safely access 500,000+ daily CRM entities in real time with zero API rate-limit violations.

Built an automated unstructured document processing pipeline powered by LLMs with strict schema validation and semantic caching, processing 25,000+ pages monthly at 98.4% accuracy and reducing incoming deal approval time from 2 days to 4 minutes.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
bullets: Modernized the core enterprise platform (70K+ LOC) with a zero-downtime migration from Django 3.2 to 4.2 LTS, extracting monolithic logic into a decoupled service layer and expanding test coverage from 28% to 76% without regressions in the transactional pipeline.

Designed a high-performance Linux microservice in Go to verify cryptographic signatures and X.509 certificates of Windows PE binaries (Authenticode), validating 2,500+ files per second with p99 latency under 12 ms and minimal memory footprint.

experience.title: Python Developer
bullets: Built a scalable distributed streaming data collection and normalization pipeline (Kafka, Faust, Playwright) across 150+ dynamic e-commerce platforms, scaling daily throughput to 18M SKUs at a 99.6% extraction success rate while cutting proxy infrastructure costs by 38%.

Optimized a high-load data ingestion gateway by migrating from synchronous Django to an asynchronous Litestar and asyncpg stack, reducing p95 latency by 56% (from 420 ms to 185 ms) and scaling node throughput from 1,200 to 4,500 RPS while cutting compute resource usage in half.

ru.name: Шамиль Абдулаев

Участник развития базового стека: 39+ принятых PR в CPython, 12 патчей в glibc, 10 коммитов в SQLAlchemy.
